# PR Review: aurora-firmware/the-intern#19 — bob chat + admin_rpc improvements

## Summary
4 findings.

| Scope | Files | Lines changed | Tier | Findings |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| source | 2 | 470 | full | 4 |

## Findings
### Source
#### [warning] `close()` races interleaved notification frames — `the-intern/service/crates/bob/src/client/admin_rpc.rs:149`
The close handshake reads one frame and assumes it's the close response; a notification arriving first would be misread as the response.
**Status:** Open

#### [minor] `params.session` sent by the client is silently ignored by the server — `the-intern/service/crates/bob/src/cli/commands/chat.rs:209`
`build_chat_send_params` sets `params.session` but nothing on the server side reads it.
**Status:** Open

#### [minor] `tokio::select!` drops the in-flight `recv()` future — `the-intern/service/crates/bob/src/cli/commands/chat.rs:182`
A latent hazard, pre-existing: `tokio::select!` drops the `subscription.recv()` future whenever the other branch fires first.
**Status:** Open

#### [minor] Frame with both `method` and a non-null `id` is misclassified — `the-intern/service/crates/bob/src/client/admin_rpc.rs:251`
A server-initiated request frame (has both `method` and a non-null `id`) would be treated as a notification by `is_notification`.
**Status:** Open

## Skipped files
None.

## Review notes
Full-tier review, source surrounding code read for both files.

**Reviewed through commit:** `54955c026`

## Findings
### Source
#### [warning] `retry_job()` re-enqueues without re-validating — `the-intern/service/crates/bob/src/queue.rs:88`
**Basis:** rule: validate jobs before enqueue (`docs/adr/0004-job-queue.md`)
`retry_job()` pushes a job back on the queue without running the validation `enqueue()` applies, contradicting the ADR's rule that every queued job is validated.

> **Developer:** Intentional — retries were already validated the first time.
> **Reviewer:** Not accepted — ADR 0004 says every enqueue is validated and makes no exception for retries; nothing shows the job is unchanged between attempts, and `retry_job()` accepts a caller-supplied payload.
**Status:** Open

#### [minor] Stale module doc on `queue` — `the-intern/service/crates/bob/src/queue.rs:1`
The module comment still says the queue is unbounded; the PR makes it bounded.

> **Developer:** Fixed in `a3f9c2d`.
> **Reviewer:** Confirmed — the comment now says bounded.
**Status:** Fixed (confirmed 2026-10-20)
